an6.91:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] cha bhikkhave dhamme abhabbo diṭṭhisampanno puggalo uppādetuṃ.
an6.91:1.3: sakkāyadiṭṭhiṃ, vicikicchaṃ, sīlabbataparāmāsaṃ, apāyagamanīyaṃ rāgaṃ, apāyagamanīyaṃ dosaṃ, apāyagamanīyaṃ mohaṃ.
an6.91:1.4: ime kho bhikkhave cha dhamme abhabbo diṭṭhisampanno puggalo uppādetunti.
